messages:
camila: quick design check: added a 'Notify multiplier' slider to the SLO threshold panel and a tiny live routing preview. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/notify-multiplier
jess: love the preview. copy nit: label the slider 'Notify multiplier (burn rate)' so PMs get context at a glance.
ron: accessibility: keyboard increments should be 0.1 with arrow keys, 0.5 with page up/down, and home/end to min/max. aria-live summary should announce changed channels only.
liz: suppressed channels question: show them in preview with '(suppressed)' and a muted icon, but de-emphasize visually. allow click to jump to quiet window settings.
camila: agreed. also add a small legend: orange = escalates, blue = notify, gray = suppressed. aria-bot: check contrast for small label text.
aria-bot: contrast check: orange #FF8C42 fails for 12px on white. suggest #E65A00 or bold labels for small text. ensure focus ring is visible in dark theme (3px).
jess: microcopy: under the slider show '1x = default. Higher values notify earlier.' keep it short.
ron: perf: throttle preview updates while dragging to 120ms and show a subtle spinner if computation takes longer.
camila: will update figma: label change, tooltip text, keyboard rules, aria attributes, legend, suppressed affordance, and throttled preview. i'll post new frames in a couple hours.
liz: add unit test for aria-valuenow updates and a visual test for suppressed state. make sure tooltip appears on focus.
camila: thanks all 389
